title: The Archive That Files Itself Deeper

features.name: recursive-file-stack
features.desc-on-touch: A tower of documents, each one filing the document that files it. You can see to the bottom, which is impossible. The bottom is also another tower, filing upward.

features.name: self-referential-card
features.desc-on-touch: A standing directory listing. Its entry reads: 'This file describes the filing of this file.' Below that: 'This file describes the filing of this file.' Below that: 'This file describes the filing of this file.'

features.name: endless-catalogue
features.desc-on-touch: A wireframe containing an inventory of itself. Every file in the inventory contains a copy of the inventory. The inventory keeps growing smaller and larger simultaneously.

features.name: document-that-indexes-itself
features.desc-on-touch: A plaque bearing the title: 'The Index of All Indexes Including This One.' It points to itself. And to the plaque that points to itself. The pointing never ends.

features.name: archive-processing-itself
features.desc-on-touch: A pool of reflected documents. Each document shows itself filing itself. The pool reflects the reflection of the reflection. Arrival never ends because processing never ceases.

inscription: each document files the one that files it; filing never ceases because arrival never ended
